customer_id.meaning: primary id of the patient/guarantor profile (content hash); one profile per patient, who is also the guarantor of their own accounts

full_name.meaning: patient's legal full name exactly as registered at the first visit; not an identity credential on its own

date_of_birth.meaning: patient's date of birth as registered; used as an identity credential

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on the registration profile; used as an identity credential

email.meaning: email address on the registration profile, lower case; used as an identity credential

medical_record_number.meaning: the system-wide medical record number (MRN) printed on wristbands, statements and portal; used as an identity credential

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the patient's Social Security number as registered; empty when the patient declined to provide it; used as an identity credential

mailing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address where paper statements are sent; used as an identity credential

county_of_residence.meaning: county of the patient's primary residence as registered; the basis for any service-area test (the address on file, not the address of the visit)

preferred_language.meaning: language the patient asked to receive notices and plain-language summaries in

profile_created_date.meaning: date the patient profile was first registered in the system

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record (one per patient)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; never downgrades from true to false

verified_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

encounter_id.meaning: primary id of the hospital account (one per registered encounter; HAR number)

customer_id.meaning: patient and guarantor of the account (foreign key -> customers)

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the account (basis defined in the encounter charter lifecycle)

final_bill_date.meaning: date the final bill dropped to the payer or patient; empty while pending_billing

hold_started_date.meaning: start date of the current billing hold; empty when not on hold
